title: Father and Son (miniquest)
start: Talk to Irwinsson, located on Anachronia, found south of the Anachronia lodestone.

recommended.t: Enchanted lyre for quick teleport to Rellekka

rewards.l: Medium Hunter XP lamp (Father and Son)

steps.t: Talk to Irwinsson. [Chat: 1 Tell me more about yourself. › Accept]
Talk to Sigli the Huntsman located at the main gate of Rellekka.
Head back to Anachronia and give Irwinsson his greatbow. [Chat: 1 Talk about Sigli.]
